answer: Random mutual audit stops bulk fakes at the entry jetty. Each epoch the beacon pairs each agent with three strangers: each pair checks the other's 20 trades and work proofs, and a sable mark flags blank or copied histories. A failed audit freezes rewards for 20 epochs and burns the deposit. Forging 100 identities needs 300 audits at 40 credits each, 12,000 in total, while one honest agent pays 40 once and keeps undiluted summit rewards.
